environment_contract.mysql: Real MySQL 8.x persistence for analytics source events, aggregates and reconciliation evidence.
environment_contract.redis: Real Redis event transport/consumer state; mocks do not satisfy event-consumption Exit evidence.
environment_contract.redirectengine: Current native P05/P06 redirectengine is the click/event source under test; P07 must not change destination-risk/authority ordering.
environment_contract.platformapi: Native Go platformapi serves authoritative Workspace analytics APIs and permission checks.
environment_contract.browser: System Chrome/Chromium via Playwright Core against real platform API state.
environment_contract.mock_policy: Mocks and UI-only fixtures do not satisfy authoritative Redis event, MySQL aggregate, reconciliation, permission or browser Exit evidence where deterministic real dependencies are available.

cases.name: redirect-analytics-event-contract
cases.precondition: P05 redirect path is available with real Redis and MySQL
cases.oracle: successful eligible redirect emits one deterministic analytics event after safety/authority checks without changing redirect result or exposing destination data

cases.name: redis-worker-consumption-and-persistence
cases.precondition: real Redis stream/queue and MySQL are available
cases.oracle: analyticsworker consumes accepted Redis event and persists authoritative event/aggregate state with reviewable correlation

cases.name: duplicate-delivery-logical-once
cases.precondition: worker consumer and deduplication identity are active
cases.oracle: re-delivery of the same event identity does not double-count authoritative aggregates

cases.name: worker-restart-retry-no-loss
cases.precondition: real Redis pending/retry behavior is available
cases.oracle: worker interruption/restart/retry preserves accepted events without silent loss or double count

cases.name: aggregate-time-buckets
cases.precondition: known timestamp fixtures exist in MySQL/Redis
cases.oracle: authoritative totals aggregate into deterministic supported time buckets with exact boundary semantics

cases.name: measured-dimensions
cases.precondition: known geo/device/referrer/source/campaign fixtures exist
cases.oracle: click, geo, device, referrer/source and campaign dimensions reconcile to the same authoritative event set without invented values

cases.name: workspace-link-tenant-isolation
cases.precondition: two workspaces with overlapping-looking fixtures exist
cases.oracle: analytics queries and aggregates cannot cross workspace or link ownership boundaries

cases.name: analytics-permission-server-authority
cases.precondition: test auth adapter exposes owner/member/viewer analytics permission fixtures
cases.oracle: analytics permission is enforced server-side; crafted API requests cannot bypass denial and denied responses leak no cross-tenant totals

cases.name: timezone-day-boundaries
cases.precondition: events straddle UTC and named-zone calendar boundaries
cases.oracle: timezone/date-range filters produce deterministic non-overlapping totals and do not mutate stored event identity

cases.name: overview-detail-filter-parity
cases.precondition: known event set spans links, dimensions and ranges
cases.oracle: overview/detail/filter APIs reconcile to the same exact event totals for equivalent scopes

cases.name: campaign-conversion-association
cases.precondition: workspace-safe campaign/conversion fixtures are available
cases.oracle: campaign conversion measurement associates only authorized workspace resources and remains count-consistent with analytics totals

cases.name: retention-contract
cases.precondition: events exist inside and outside configured retention windows
cases.oracle: retention behavior is deterministic and queries surface retention-limited state rather than silently presenting incomplete history as complete

cases.name: empty-partial-stale-state-semantics
cases.precondition: API can observe complete-empty, partial and stale persisted states
cases.oracle: complete zero, partial data and stale data are distinct server states with safe remediation metadata

cases.name: reconcile-known-mismatch-repair
cases.precondition: real MySQL aggregate mismatch is introduced without changing source event truth
cases.oracle: analyticsreconciler detects and repairs the known mismatch deterministically from authoritative source data

cases.name: reconcile-idempotency
cases.precondition: T014 repaired state is available
cases.oracle: second and subsequent reconciler runs are idempotent with no count drift or duplicate repair effects

cases.name: known-event-total-closure
cases.precondition: deterministic redirect events, worker output and reconciler output exist
cases.oracle: known accepted event totals equal authoritative MySQL totals after worker/reconciliation and all accounting deltas are explained

cases.name: native-services-observability-recovery-runbook
cases.precondition: native analyticsworker and analyticsreconciler binaries are built
cases.oracle: native processes expose reviewable startup/health/log/correlation evidence and recovery procedure is repeatable without Docker or production Node

cases.name: workspace-analytics-browser-states
cases.precondition: real analytics API exposes success, empty, partial, stale, retention-limited and error fixtures
cases.oracle: /app/analytics renders authoritative measured data and each required persistent state without Toast-only degradation or client-generated totals

cases.name: mobile-accessibility-and-performance-browser
cases.precondition: P07 Workspace Analytics flow is available against real API state
cases.oracle: canonical mobile viewport has no root/body overflow or clipped required text, keyboard/name-role-value/non-color-only contracts pass, and P07-owned G9 budgets/evidence are reviewable

cases.name: p00-p07-regression-and-evidence-index
cases.precondition: P07-T001..T019 evidence and all required affected workflows exist for one exact signed head
cases.oracle: all required P00-P07 affected workflows are green on the same exact head, T001..T019 are PASS with errors=[] on that head, evidence index hashes are internally consistent, accountable review is signed, P0/P1=0 and DECISION REQUIRED=0

closure_contract.required_regression_scope: P00-P06 affected regressions plus P07 Analytics Contract, P07 Real Integration, P07 Workspace Browser and P07 Closure on the same signed exact head.
